description: This file contains extension methods for configuring streaming services within Orleans silo and client environments, including registration of related dependencies and stream filters.

classes.name: StreamingServiceCollectionExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for setting up streaming infrastructure in Orleans silos and clients.

methods.name: AddSiloStreaming
methods.description: Configures and adds the necessary streaming services for an Orleans silo.

methods.name: AddClientStreaming
methods.description: Configures and adds streaming services for an Orleans client.

methods.name: AddStreamFilter
methods.description: Registers a stream filter by type and name in the service collection.
